# minecraft-api (MAPI)

> MAPI: a loader-neutral Java API for other mods plus an optional, local,
> secured HTTP API for external tools (LLM agents, dashboards, harnesses).

- **Minecraft 26.2**, Java 25, Fabric + NeoForge from one shared codebase.
- The local HTTP API is **disabled by default**, binds loopback only, and
  requires a bearer token (auto-generated into `<gameDir>/mcapi/token`).
- Full surface: `docs/http-api.md` (schemas in `docs/openapi.yaml`); task
  recipes in `docs/RECIPES.md`; capability model in `docs/CAPABILITIES.md`.

## What ships

| Area | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Session identity | `processSessionId` / `worldSessionId` / `physicalSide` on every identity payload; discovery file + heartbeat |
| Tasks | `POST /api/v1/tasks` → 202 + `Location`; states, progress, partial effects, cancellation, wall-time deadlines; `Idempotency-Key` replay |
| Events | per-session monotonic `seq`, polling + WebSocket stream, explicit GAP semantics, single-use browser tickets |
| Server reads | status, players (paginated/field-selected), block, block entity (typed NBT JSON), container storage, world time |
| Commands | console execution with a permission ceiling and audit events |
| Leases | `client.input/ui/camera`, `server.tick`, `world.bulkEdit` — expiring, renewable, reject/queue/preempt |
| Client evidence | status, best-effort screen tree, input-mode key actions, PNG screenshots with `frameId` |
| Inspection | registry/tag/mod listings, threads, memory GC, logs, crash reports, per-op capabilities |
| Extension SPI | mods expose operations under `/api/v1/ext/{id}/…` via the public Java API |
| Unsafe surface | reflection/invoke behind `unsafe.execute` + `reflection.enabled` (documented: no sandbox) |
| Files | sandboxed game-dir access with denylist, behind `files.*` scopes + `files.enabled` |

## Agent tooling

- **SDKs**: `sdk/python` (stdlib-only), `sdk/java`, `sdk/typescript`
  (Node 22+, zero deps) — token-file auth, discovery parsing, task polling
  with idempotency, event cursors with gap reporting.
- **MCP adapter** (`mcp-adapter`): Model Context Protocol server over stdio —
  `mcp-adapter --game-dir <dir>` exposes observe/capabilities/schema/world/
  player/commands/ui/lifecycle/task.wait/task.cancel/artifact.get tools.
- **Harness library** (`harness`): discovery validation, staleness rules
  (heartbeat age + PID identity, never PID alone), readiness waiting.

## Start here (agents)

1. `AGENTS.md` — authoritative rules, commands, recipes.
2. `./gradlew llmContext` → `build/llm/CONTEXT.md` (bounded repo snapshot).
3. `docs/llm-workflow.md` for the read → propose → implement → verify loop.

## Verification

```bash
./gradlew verify    # format, 147+ tests, jar validation, manifest
```

Game-run checks (dedicated-server smoke, launch matrix, client
verification) are EULA/operator-gated — see `docs/TESTING.md` for the
executed vs NOT RUN inventory.
